summary: Focused regression test of small UI tweak: white color directly selectable (replacing 'none/X' reset) in Admin > App-udseende section (App-baggrundsfarve + Sideoverskrift-farve rows only). Backend: added 1 new pytest test (test_white_color_both_fields_persists) to existing test_admin_appearance.py, all 5/5 tests passing, confirming PUT/GET /api/admin/settings correctly persists {app_bg_color:'#FFFFFF', page_title_color:'#FFFFFF'}. Frontend (mobile viewport 375x667, Playwright): verified admin-app-bg-color-white and admin-page-title-color-white testIDs render as plain white circle swatches (not X icon), old admin-app-bg-color-none/admin-page-title-color-none testIDs are correctly absent, each row shows exactly 10 total swatches (1 white + 9 non-white from SWATCH_COLORS filtered to remove duplicate white). Tapping white swatch shows dark checkmark (COLORS.textPrimary) as expected. Save button triggers 'Udseende gemt' toast successfully. Verified all 5 tabs (Dagsoversigt/Agamer checked directly) apply white background; title text became invisible when both app_bg_color and page_title_color set to white (white-on-white) - this is expected logical consequence of the color choice, not a bug. Regression: Banner section's admin-bg-color-none and admin-heading-color-none testIDs confirmed still present and unchanged (count=1 each). Test data restored to original null/default state after testing; banner_bg_color (#1C1917) and heading_color (#F2CC8F) confirmed untouched.

issues: Minor UX note (not a bug): selecting white for both app_bg_color and page_title_color makes page title text invisible (white-on-white) on all 5 tabs since there's no automatic contrast check. This is consistent with any matching bg/text color pair chosen by admin and is likely acceptable given it's an intentional user choice, but flagging for awareness.

action_items: No blocking issues found. The white-swatch replacement for 'none' in App-udseende section works correctly end-to-end (UI rendering, testIDs, save, persistence, and Banner section regression unaffected).

Optional/non-blocking: consider whether admin should be warned or given a contrast hint when selecting the same/similar color for both app_bg_color and page_title_color, since it can render title text invisible. Not required for this small UI tweak's scope.
critical_code_review_comments: admin.tsx: new white swatch buttons for App-baggrundsfarve/Sideoverskrift-farve rows correctly reuse styles.swatch + styles.swatchWhite, hardcode onPress to '#FFFFFF', and filter SWATCH_COLORS to exclude '#FFFFFF' in the mapped list (SWATCH_COLORS.filter(c => c !== '#FFFFFF')) to avoid duplicate white swatches - clean implementation matching the requested change exactly.
Banner section's swatchNone/'none' reset buttons (admin-bg-color-none, admin-heading-color-none) were left untouched as required - correctly scoped change, no regression introduced.
No backend changes were needed or made; AppSettingsUpdate model already accepts any Optional[str] hex value including '#FFFFFF'.

success_rate.frontend: 100% - all requested checks for this UI tweak passed
